name: 恶魔天使
english_description: A Chinese wuxia/xianxia MUD explicitly "modified from the es2 1.1e mudlib" (its own README states this in so many words, and README.ES2 -- the original es2 mudlib's own readme, credited to Annihilator, 1994-95 -- ships unmodified alongside it), sharing the ES II engine's full framework (adm/ daemons, feature/ mixin classes such as action/attack/dbase/treemap/equip/move/save/skill/team, the same GB-encoding chinese.lpc/logind.lpc byte-range name-validation bug, the same 2-arg valid_override()/destruct()-as-simul_efun/tell_room() driver-incompatibility classes already catalogued for es2 and the rest of this project's ES2/haiyang2/xkx2001 family) but with a completely different, self-contained game world: domains named gourd (start room, a hub city literally named after a calabash/gourd), grid, pet, ship, special, and wiz, versus es2's canyon/choyin/city/force/temple/village -- confirmed not a duplicate of es2 or any other onboarded ES2-family lib. Notably ships a `feature/irc.lpc` combat-team-formation mixin (an in-game party/team system, not an actual IRC bridge) and a full but entirely disabled `adm/daemons/network/` Intermud-style subsystem (dns_master, mail_serv, ftpd, etc. -- all excluded from adm/etc/preload in the original archive, confirmed making zero outbound connections at boot). 709 .lpc files; a from-scratch lpcc compile sweep found 41 initial failures, of which 19 were genuine driver-incompatibility or author-typo bugs (fixed: the es2-lineage 2-arg valid_override(), destruct()/exec() simul_efun overrides, log_file() missing assure_file() guard, is_chinese()/check_legal_name() GBK-byte-range vs CJK-codepoint mismatch, an unclosed string literal masquerading as a heredoc syntax error in two files sharing a copy-pasted "马厩\" stable description, an unescaped-quote string bug in include/ship.h's ship-saving code generator, the non-existent tail() efun, a stray extra parenthesis, a dropped variable declaration in cmds/usr/mount.lpc, a cross-inherit clean_up(int) signature mismatch that silently truncated std/room.lpc's entire door subsystem out of visibility whenever the file was compiled as an inherited dependency, and a carry_object() helper that didn't honor its own 0-on-failure contract when move() silently failed because NPCs -- unlike player characters -- never get max_encumbrance initialized) and the remaining 22 are confirmed pre-existing, deliberately-disabled, or genuinely-missing content (an entire commented-out std/room.lpc door subsystem the one live caller was orphaned from, F_CLOTH/CLOTH and F_FOOD/POWDER feature classes referenced by exactly one file each but never shipped, a "move" skill referenced by one NPC with no matching skill-daemon file, and the same dead adm/daemons/network/ tree plus assorted bak/doc/example scaffolding also found dead in es2). Booted clean on the real driver and verified end-to-end with a real Chinese name (秦风): full registration flow, landing in the gourd-city central plaza (中央广场, /d/gourd/gourd_recall), look/score/who/say/whoami/relogin all correct, and a clean quit with both save files written.
